'''Skrall''' was the name of a [[Sleen/Legends|Sleen]] which escaped from the [[Coronet Zoo]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] around [[3640 BBY]] and was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Skrall appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
